name: corpus-cloud-pricing-mcp

tools.name: catalog
tools.description: Free. Providers, region slugs, coverage windows, prices per call and the source legend. Call first.

tools.name: instances
tools.description: Free. Instance types available in a region with coverage dates.

region.description: Region slug from the catalog tool (e.g. us-east-1, us-central1, us-east)

tools.name: gpu_models
tools.description: Free. Normalized GPU model names with quote counts and providers.

tools.name: index_tickers
tools.description: Free. Every index ticker (CX.<MODEL>.<SEGMENT>) with segment definitions and the methodology version.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Free. Freshness of every data source.

tools.name: spot_daily
tools.description: Paid (0.05 USDC). Full daily spot price history of one instance type, all eras, source per row.

region.description: Region slug from the catalog tool (e.g. us-east-1, us-central1, us-east)

instance.description: Instance type exactly as listed by the instances tool (e.g. c5.large)

tools.name: spot_hourly
tools.description: Paid (0.01 USDC). Hourly time-weighted OHLC spot bars for one instance type.

region.description: Region slug from the catalog tool (e.g. us-east-1, us-central1, us-east)

instance.description: Instance type exactly as listed by the instances tool (e.g. c5.large)

tools.name: spot_events
tools.description: Paid (0.01 USDC). Raw spot price-change events for one instance type with zone and timestamp.

region.description: Region slug from the catalog tool (e.g. us-east-1, us-central1, us-east)

instance.description: Instance type exactly as listed by the instances tool (e.g. c5.large)

tools.name: spot_latest
tools.description: Paid (0.01 USDC). Current spot price per zone for one instance type.

region.description: Region slug from the catalog tool (e.g. us-east-1, us-central1, us-east)

instance.description: Instance type exactly as listed by the instances tool (e.g. c5.large)

tools.name: spot_snapshot
tools.description: Paid (0.10 USDC). Current spot price of every type and zone in a region.

region.description: Region slug from the catalog tool (e.g. us-east-1, us-central1, us-east)

tools.name: spot_monthly
tools.description: Paid (0.05 USDC). Monthly spot history back to 2014 for legacy AWS types.

region.description: Region slug from the catalog tool (e.g. us-east-1, us-central1, us-east)

instance.description: Instance type exactly as listed by the instances tool (e.g. c5.large)

tools.name: ondemand
tools.description: Paid (0.01 USDC). On-demand list-price change history of one instance type.

region.description: Region slug from the catalog tool (e.g. us-east-1, us-central1, us-east)

instance.description: Instance type exactly as listed by the instances tool (e.g. c5.large)

tools.name: reserved
tools.description: Paid (0.01 USDC). AWS reserved-instance effective hourly price history (1y/3y, no/all upfront).

region.description: Region slug from the catalog tool (e.g. us-east-1, us-central1, us-east)

instance.description: Instance type exactly as listed by the instances tool (e.g. c5.large)

tools.name: gpu_quotes
tools.description: Paid (0.01 USDC). Latest GPU rental quotes for one model across neo-clouds and marketplaces, USD per GPU-hour.

tools.name: gpu_index
tools.description: Paid (0.05 USDC). Daily lo/median/mean/hi per provider and market for one GPU model, with aws-spot and gcp-spot legs.

tools.name: index_fixing
tools.description: Paid (0.01 USDC). One day's index fixing for a ticker such as CX.H100SXM.NEO (median USD per GPU-hour, lo, hi, n).

tools.name: index_history
tools.description: Paid (0.05 USDC). Daily fixings for a ticker; SPOT tickers reach back to 2022.

tools.name: index_board
tools.description: Paid (0.10 USDC). Every ticker's fixing for one day.

tools.name: capacity_stress
tools.description: Paid (0.01 USDC). Capacity stress score for one GPU model on one day, 0 (slack) to 100 (tight), with every component (availability, io.net units, Vast supply, spot-to-on-demand ratio).

tools.name: capacity_history
tools.description: Paid (0.05 USDC). Daily capacity stress scores for one GPU model.

tools.name: capacity_board
tools.description: Paid (0.10 USDC). Every GPU model's capacity stress score for one day, tightest first.

tools.name: tokens_models
tools.description: Free. Every LLM with a token price fixing: canonical slug, ticker codes, sources, hosts and today's price range, plus the frontier basket.

tools.name: tokens_quotes
tools.description: Paid (0.01 USDC). Every source and host's price for one model on one day, USD per million input/output tokens.

tools.name: tokens_fixing
tools.description: Paid (0.01 USDC). One day's token price fixing for CX.TOK.<MODEL>.IN, .OUT or .BLEND, or CX.TOK.FRONTIER.<side>.

tools.name: tokens_history
tools.description: Paid (0.05 USDC). Daily fixings for a token ticker.

tools.name: tokens_board
tools.description: Paid (0.10 USDC). Every model's input, output and blended fixing for one day plus the frontier basket.

tools.name: term_instance
tools.description: Paid (0.01 USDC). Price ladder for one instance type: spot, on-demand, 1-year and 3-year commitments with discount to on-demand.

region.description: Region slug from the catalog tool (e.g. us-east-1, us-central1, us-east)

instance.description: Instance type exactly as listed by the instances tool (e.g. c5.large)

tools.name: term_curve
tools.description: Paid (0.05 USDC). Term structure per hyperscaler for one GPU model, USD per GPU-hour: spot, on-demand, 1y, 3y with discounts.

gpu.description: Model with a hyperscaler mapping, e.g. "H100 SXM", "T4"

instructions: corpusAI Cloud Pricing: spot, on-demand, reserved, GPU rental and LLM token prices with index fixings. Call catalog / gpu_models / index_tickers first (free), then the paid tools; each paid call costs 0.01 to 0.10 USDC, paid over x402 from the Circle Gateway balance of CORPUS_PAYER_KEY automatically. To pay with a prepaid key or over MPP instead, use the hosted server at smallprint-placeholder/mcp or the API directly. Docs: smallprint-placeholder/docs, methodology: smallprint-placeholder/methodology.md.
